name: Lucky Lightning

features.name: Expanding grid
features.description: Lightning symbols can enlarge the grid to bigger formations.

features.name: Wild Respin and Collect
features.description: Two wilds start a money-symbol respin round.

review:
A 243-ways game where the grid can grow. Lightning symbols on the first two reels can expand the layout, adding rows to reels three to five or six.

Two wilds on the first two reels trigger Wild Respin and Collect, where you try to land as many money symbols as possible – fill the sixth reel and reels three, four and five respin. A separate free spins mode can give up to 50 games on a 3x6 grid. 96.45% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
